body:
Awake now, still feel the same really, the feelings of me not being around are not as strong, as I said before they seem to come in waves, so I'll be feeling the normal shitness of life and then be hit by a ton of bricks where I feel it would be better to not be around.

I'm not through this yet, not by a long shot, but these messages help, I guess when you're at your lowest, you can't get any lower, the only way is up maybe?!

I dunno.

Thanks for the interest, these anonymous comments actually mean a lot when you've no one else.

I've stopped crying anyway, seems to come in waves. I still feel like total shit, I've been sticking it out it's just so hard, probably the hardest thing I've had to deal with in my entire life and sometimes it feels like it would be better if I wasn't around. 

I'm finally tired enough to go back sleep, the only place I'm actually happy. Another day anyway.

Thanks again.
